title: Alert List
description: Notification centre composing the @moderno-ui/{framework} Alert, Button and Card primitives: a stack of dismissible status alerts in all four variants, with its own empty, loading and error renders and a heading it takes as a prop; responds to its container (@container) across all three contract steps — the header lines up at @sm, each dismiss control grows its label at @md, each timestamp moves to the trailing edge at @lg.
